items.control_name: Enforce AWS Control Tower Landing Zone with Preventive & Detective Guardrails
items.description: The AWS Organization must be managed by AWS Control Tower with mandatory preventive SCPs and detective AWS Config rules active across all OUs.
items.current_value: Control Tower Landing Zone v3.3 active; 14 mandatory and 6 strongly recommended guardrails enabled
items.recommended_value: Control Tower deployed with 100% OU enrollment
items.remediation_notes: Ensure new member accounts are provisioned exclusively via AWS Service Catalog Account Factory.

items.control_name: Enforce Dedicated Security Log Archive & Audit Accounts
items.description: Centralized CloudTrail and AWS Config logs must be shipped to a dedicated Log Archive account with restricted IAM access.
items.current_value: Dedicated 'Log Archive' (998877665544) and 'Security Audit' accounts operational
items.recommended_value: Dedicated Log Archive & Security Audit accounts with zero workload deployment
items.remediation_notes: Verify SCP blocks root account login on Log Archive account.

items.control_name: Restrict AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) Sharing to Within the Organization
items.description: AWS RAM must prohibit sharing Transit Gateways, Subnets, and Resolver Rules with external AWS accounts outside the organization.
items.current_value: RAM Organization sharing enabled; external sharing disabled
items.remediation_notes: Audit any explicit RAM invitations to third-party vendor accounts.

items.control_name: Enforce Centralized Egress via Shared Network Inspection Hub
items.description: VPCs in workload accounts must route outbound Internet egress through a centralized AWS Network Firewall / Transit Gateway hub.
items.current_value: Transit Gateway hub 'tgw-prod-hub' routing egress through AWS Network Firewall
items.recommended_value: 100% of workload VPC egress inspected at centralized network hub
items.remediation_notes: Monitor Network Firewall drop metrics and TLS SNI filtering rules.
